special.label: Special
special.hint: A supplemental ability that can't be added onto the same attack as another Special ability. It can be combined with other supplemental abilities.

AbilityRank.TooHigh: {name}: rank {rank} is above its highest stat ({stat} {value}).
AbilityRank.OutOfRange: {name}: rank must be 0 (not taken) or from {min} to {max}.

Progression.Title: Character Progression
Progression.Hint: Stat points, ability points, skills and stat caps for each character level.
Progression.TableHint: What a character gains on reaching each level. Level 1 is what a new character starts with. Unspent points carry over to later levels.
Progression.FreeRespecHint: While building or levelling up a character, points spent at earlier levels can be taken back and spent again. Off: earlier choices are locked, and only a GM can change them.

Build.EnterHint: Spend stat points, ability points and skills.
Build.LockSettingHint: Players can't enter build mode or change their character's level; the GM does it for them. Raising a character's level still puts it in build mode.
Build.Locked: Character building is locked by the GM.
Build.LevelLocked: Only the GM can change a character's level while building is locked.
Build.DrGmOnly: Only the GM can change a character's PDR and MDR.
Build.DamageGmOnly: Only the GM can change a basic attack's damage.
Build.NotBuilding: Enter build mode to change stats, ability ranks and skills.
Build.StatLockedIn: {stat} can't go below {value}: points spent at earlier levels are locked in.
Build.StatFromRacial: {stat} can't go below {value}: those ranks come from Stat Increase. Remove the racial skill to take them back.
Build.RankLockedIn: {name} can't go below rank {rank}: points spent at earlier levels are locked in.
Build.ItemLockedIn: {name} can't be removed: it was taken at an earlier level.
Build.StatNeeded: {stats} can't be lowered: {abilities} need it for their rank. Lower those abilities first.
Build.UnspentWarning: Unspent: {stats} stat points, {abilities} ability points, {skills} skills. Character building is locked, so you won't be able to spend them until the GM lets you. Finish anyway?

Builder.Title: Build {name}
Builder.Name: Name
Builder.StatsHint: Each rank costs a stat point. Stats can't go above {cap} at this level.
Builder.AbilitiesHint: Each rank costs an ability point, and taking an ability costs its minimum rank. An ability's rank can't go above the highest of its stats.
Builder.CustomSkill: Or add a skill by name
Builder.FinishHint: Finish when you're done. Points left over carry over to your next level.
Builder.NotBuilding: This character isn't in build mode, so nothing can be changed here.

Breather.Label: Breather
Breather.Hint: Breather: Restore Health and Stamina to full and remove all conditions. Wounds stay.

RacialSkill.Title: Racial Skills
RacialSkill.Empty: Drag racial skills here from the compendium.
RacialSkill.CharactersOnly: Only characters can have racial skills.
RacialSkill.Duplicate: This character already has that racial skill, and it can only be taken once.
RacialSkill.Exclusive: {name} can't be taken with any other racial skill.
RacialSkill.Limit: A character can only have {max} racial skills.
RacialSkill.AllStatsChosen: No stat is left to pick for {name}: each one has it already or is at the stat cap.
RacialSkill.NoSkillChosen: Pick a skill or enter one's name.
RacialSkill.ChooseAbility: Which ability does {name} give a rank in?
RacialSkill.AbilityNotAllowed: {name} can't gain a rank from this: it's at its highest rank, needs a higher stat, or another copy is already for it.
RacialSkill.NoAbilityLeft: No ability can gain a rank from {name}: each one is at its highest rank, needs a higher stat, or already has it.

Field.Repeatable: Can be taken more than once

Skill.Empty: Drag skills here from the compendium, or add your own with +.
Skill.Migrated: Skills are now items: converted the skills of {count} character(s).

Boon.Title: Boons
Boon.CountHint: A boss gets 1 boon at levels 1-5, 2 at levels 6-10 and 3 from level 11
Boon.Empty: Drag boons here from the compendium, or add your own with +.
Boon.BossesOnly: Only bosses have boons. Tick Boss on the monster's sheet first.
Boon.MinLevelHint: The lowest level of monster this boon is designed for (empty for any)
Boon.TooLow: This boon is designed for monsters level {level} or higher.
Boon.GrantsWoundsHint: The boss uses the wound rules: health resets when it reaches 0, wounds make its rolls worse, and it dies at 3 wounds
Boon.GrantsAdvantageHint: The boss makes every d100 check with advantage. Disadvantage (such as Poisoned) cancels it out as usual

RollMode.Forced: {condition} forces this roll to be made with disadvantage.
RollMode.Cancelled: {advantage} and {disadvantage} cancel each other out, so this roll is made normally.

NOQUARTER.NoUsesLeft: {name} has no uses left this combat.

Turn.WaitingForGM: Waiting for the GM to say who attacks first.

Blocked.SomeoneActive: Someone is already taking their turn.
Blocked.NoSide: The GM has not said who attacks first yet.
Blocked.NotYourSide: It is not your side's turn.
Blocked.NobodyReady: Nobody on that side can go.
Blocked.NotYourTurn: Tokens can only be moved on their own turn, once it has been started.

Hit.DragHint: Drag onto a token or an actor sheet to apply
Hit.NoToken: Drop the hit onto a token to apply it.
Hit.NoGM: A GM must be connected to apply a hit to {name}.
Hit.AskTypePrompt: This damage has no type. Is it physical or magical?
Hit.Stays: Gains {condition}, but already has {current}, so it stays at {current}

AttackBox.None: No supplemental abilities can be added to this attack.
AttackBox.NotEnough: {name} doesn't have enough stamina ({cost} needed, {stamina} available).
AttackBox.GiveUp: Give up the remaining {count} attack(s)? Stamina already spent isn't refunded.

AttackLimit.label: Attack Limit
AttackLimit.hint: How often this can be added onto attacks in the attack box. A limited ability is chosen again for each attack instead of carrying over.
AttackLimit.perTurn: Its value in attacks per turn
AttackLimit.oneHit: Until it lands one hit (one target)

Scaling.baseHint: The number in the effect at the ability's minimum rank, which grows with rank. Leave empty if the effect has none.

ImposeCondition.ChoiceHint: Asks which condition this imposes when a character takes it. It can be taken once for each condition.
ImposeCondition.AllChosen: {name} has already been taken for every condition.
